outcome: Fertility (natural conception, assisted reproduction, surrogacy, adoption)
Pregnancy (planned/unplanned, termination, miscarriages, complications like exacerbations of lung disease, gestational diabetes, gastrointestinal bleeding, pre-eclampsia)
Parenthood (number of children, step-parent role, children's age at maternal death)
cohort: The participants are a total cohort of 217 women with cystic fibrosis.
finding: Despite generally good outcomes, pre-conception planning in women with cystic fibrosis is suboptimal, pregnancy is associated with increased complications, and parenthood presents complex issues regarding prognosis.
mod_finding: Delivery was by caesarean section in 14 (40%) of the completed pregnancies.
cross-section timing: The study assessed the 'current state' of relationships, fertility, pregnancy and parenthood, and recorded pregnancies between 2020 and 2024.
